# rappi-mcp-unofficial

Unofficial local-first MCP for personal Rappi use (Brazil default).

- Install: `npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial`
- Auth: `npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial auth --token <personal-token>`
- Doctor: `npx -y rappi-mcp-unofficial doctor`
- Default: read-only. Never pays.
- To charge: `RAPPI_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true` AND tool argument `explicit_user_intent: true`.
- Not Rappi Partners. Consumer web/app surface; unstable.
- Tokens live in `~/.rappi-mcp/tokens.json` (0600), never in the npm tarball.
